scenarios.title: Exact v4 → v7 and valid grouping
scenarios.expected: The approved hashes produce C17 and C18 only. The temporary v5 field leaves no net change. C18 describes field presence.

scenarios.title: Baseline hash mismatch
scenarios.expected: Changed v4 bytes return HTTP 422 with no artifact. The grouping provider is never called.

scenarios.title: Target hash mismatch
scenarios.expected: Changed v7 bytes return HTTP 422 with no artifact. The grouping provider is never called.

scenarios.title: Omitted change
scenarios.expected: The grouping drops C18. The API publishes the complete rules summary with C17 and C18.

scenarios.title: Duplicate change
scenarios.expected: The grouping repeats C17. The API publishes the complete rules summary.

scenarios.title: Fabricated change
scenarios.expected: The grouping includes C99. The API publishes the complete rules summary.

scenarios.title: Disallowed topic
scenarios.expected: The grouping assigns C17 to exceptions. The API publishes the complete rules summary.

scenarios.title: Unverified prose
scenarios.expected: The grouping claims that entering a reason is mandatory. The API publishes only the verified rules text.

scenarios.title: Trailing content
scenarios.expected: A second JSON value follows the grouping document. The API publishes the complete rules summary.

scenarios.title: Invalid JSON
scenarios.expected: The API rejects malformed grouping JSON and publishes the complete rules summary.

scenarios.title: Grouping timeout
scenarios.expected: The provider reports a timeout. The existing verified rules artifact stays published.

scenarios.title: Grouping input limit
scenarios.expected: The provider reports that its input limit was reached. The existing verified rules artifact stays published.

scenarios.title: Grouping budget exhausted
scenarios.expected: The provider reports budget exhaustion. The existing verified rules artifact stays published.

scenarios.title: Unsupported material edit
scenarios.expected: The API sends the whole summary for editorial review without publishing a partial artifact.

scenarios.title: Original French view receipt
scenarios.expected: v8 contains only C17. The receipt still returns the original French v7 artifact with C17, C18 and both approved hashes. An invalid v8 grouping leaves its published artifact unchanged.

scenarios.title: Receipt from a previous mock instance
scenarios.expected: After generating v8 in a fresh mock, the old v7 receipt and summary version return HTTP 404. The new receipt returns the v8 artifact.
